gh pr create *.reason: Allow gh pr create with multi-line body

git commit *.reason: Allow git commit with multi-line messages

gh issue create *.reason: Allow gh issue create with multi-line body

git -C *.suggestion: Run git commands from the target directory directly instead of using `git -C`.

\\bgit\\b.*\\$\\(cat\\b.suggestion: Pass arguments directly (e.g., `-m "message"`) instead of using `$(cat <<'EOF' ...)`.

\\bgh\\b.*\\$\\(cat\\b.suggestion: Pass arguments directly (e.g., `--title "title" --body "body"`) instead of using `$(cat <<'EOF' ...)`.

^echo\\b.suggestion: Do not use `echo` for separators/markers or to write files. Use separate Bash calls, `&&` chaining, or the Write/Edit tools instead.

^sed\\b.suggestion: Use the Edit or Read tool instead of `sed`.

^gh\\s+api\\b.*\\brepos/\\S+/contents\\b.reason: Fetching file content via `gh api repos/.../contents/...` is forbidden.
^gh\\s+api\\b.*\\brepos/\\S+/contents\\b.suggestion: Clone the repository into `.local/src/github.com/<owner>/<repo>` and read the files locally with the Read tool instead.

^git\\b[^\"']*\\s--no-verify\\b|^git\\s+.suggestion: The commit-msg and pre-commit hooks block attribution lines and private endpoints from reaching a repository. Fix what they report instead of bypassing them.

^(?:timeout\\s+\\S+\\s+)?curl\\b.suggestion: For GitHub data use `claude-tools gh <command>` or `gh release download`; for public web pages use WebFetch. Anything else, ask the user to run it themselves (`! curl ...`) and paste the result.

^gh\\s+api\\b.*\\s(?:-X|--method)[= ]?\\.reason: `gh api` with a write method (PUT, PATCH, DELETE) is forbidden.
^gh\\s+api\\b.*\\s(?:-X|--method)[= ]?\\.suggestion: Repository and organization settings are managed as code. Describe the change to the user and let them apply it.
